invfarming:farming-fallow-body:
After every harvest your farmland will turn into fallow. In order to use it again you need to re-till it using your trusty hoe. You can also simply 'destroy' the fallow in order to turn it back into farmland, but that will cause it to lose 5% of every nutrient type.

Farmland gains +10% to it's base fertility as long as it stays under fallow, but only then. As soon as it's re-tilled its nutrients will start slowly drifting towards its regular fertility. Re-till your farmland just before sowing for the best results!
